status: baseline ranking / twelve redesigns completed / awaiting user review
scope: 14 current original masters plus 20 refined Century masters; ten queued concepts excluded
basis: Comparative editorial judgement, not a scientific measurement. Ranking prioritises ultrawide masters; Century compact layouts were reviewed in the preceding refinement. Current compact parity of the original fourteen has not been re-audited in this ranking.
criteria: Plausible visible construction and purposeful detail
Narrative, factoids and humour integrated with the device
Whole-sheet consistency and honest labelling of illustrative data

cutoff.why: Through rank 22, form, mechanism and story reinforce each other without a central visual redesign. Below it, the main subject needs new form, composition or a corrected explanatory panel. Added parts and text alone no longer close the gap.
cutoff.boundary_note: Queue Garden is the closest call. Exact order within a tier is less important than the boundary.
cutoff.application_note: User authorized redesigning the twelve; all 34 remain in the collection. No membership removal or post-redesign promotion.

wallpapers.title: FUSION TRANSPORT
wallpapers.reason: The best balance of shaped structure, exposed systems and restrained negative space.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep as the hardware composition benchmark.

wallpapers.title: TRUTH LAMP
wallpapers.reason: The scene, annotations and statistics tell the same joke at three levels.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep as the narrative benchmark; fictional detector claims remain fiction.

wallpapers.title: SKY RACER
wallpapers.reason: Distinctive swept silhouette; the cockpit section adds information rather than another outline.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep the cockpit and vehicle relationship as a reference.

wallpapers.title: NEUTRINO BELL
wallpapers.reason: Layered, inspectable apparatus with strong depth and a distinctive central silhouette.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep as the benchmark for nested mechanical detail.

wallpapers.title: TETHER CLIMBER
wallpapers.reason: The hero, system scale and ribbon structure explain different aspects of one invention.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep as the auxiliary-view benchmark.

wallpapers.title: LIGHT SAIL
wallpapers.reason: Large membrane, fine tension systems and a small core establish unusually clear hierarchy.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; preserve the contrast between delicate rigging and open area.

wallpapers.title: QUANTUM SIMULATOR
wallpapers.reason: The ring architecture has a recognizable identity, supported by distinct technical insets.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; retain the explicit distinction between code schematic and speculative hardware.

wallpapers.title: FIBRE BRAID
wallpapers.reason: Radial carriers, converging fibres and the long mandrel make the function visually legible.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; the authored feed paths carry the detail rather than surface decoration.

wallpapers.title: PROXY
wallpapers.reason: The running silhouette and absent head make the premise immediate; owner and tread insets add character.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; any future rig changes still require pose review.

wallpapers.title: PLANT ALIBI
wallpapers.reason: A plant and a recorder form a memorable subject, and the conflicting logs finish the story.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep as a compact example of evidence-based visual humour.

wallpapers.title: ORGAN FOUNDRY
wallpapers.reason: Open-frame equipment, the specimen and tissue inset form a coherent multi-scale sheet.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; the large frame could eventually gain more shaped surfaces.

wallpapers.title: CORTICAL MESH
wallpapers.reason: The implant stack and contact array give a distinct scale and technical rhythm.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; the main object is planar by nature, but the auxiliary layers explain its depth.

wallpapers.title: MEMORY KILN
wallpapers.reason: A composed laboratory object, readable optical path and physical decoding guide support a specific story.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; further polish should shape the bridge, not add arbitrary screws.

wallpapers.title: DUNE SKIMMER
wallpapers.reason: A strong rover silhouette with distinctive wheels and an honest physical diagram.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; avoid expanding the canopy until it overwhelms the vehicle.

wallpapers.title: SOCK ORACLE
wallpapers.reason: The mechanical cradle and sorting case file make an ordinary chore into a convincing artifact.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; the drum is simple, but its service view and narrative earn their space.

wallpapers.title: COMPLIMENT MILL
wallpapers.reason: The optical head, inspection tray and receipt create a coherent character and workflow.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; the tapered body remains plain but subordinate to meaningful working parts.

wallpapers.title: PETAL EYE
wallpapers.reason: Recognizable optical architecture, light supports and useful aperture information.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; it is less original than the top tier but consistently composed.

wallpapers.title: LUNAR PORCH
wallpapers.reason: A readable pressure boundary, shaped frame, seals and dust tray give the object a specific purpose.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; the empty suit interface is intentional and documented.

wallpapers.title: GREENER
wallpapers.reason: Distinctive social satire with organic material and technical equipment in one composition.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep; fine grass detail is weaker at thumbnail size, so it sits below the benchmark tier.

wallpapers.title: AIR REFINERY
wallpapers.reason: A coherent vertical vessel and process diagram connect hardware to inputs and outputs.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep at the lower end; the cylindrical tower is less distinctive than the leaders.

wallpapers.title: BOUNDER
wallpapers.reason: The equipped runner gives the central mechanism scale and use; material detail adds a second reading.
wallpapers.next_step: Keep at the lower end; pose and equipment orientation remain sensitive to future edits.

wallpapers.title: ADVICE FILTER
wallpapers.reason: The shutter mechanism directly expresses consent, and the timing panel extends the joke.
wallpapers.next_step: Proposed last member of the main set; modest form, but unusually coherent purpose.

wallpapers.title: QUEUE GARDEN
wallpapers.reason: The event chart and joke are strong, but the potted stem reads more as a novelty ornament than intricate hardware.
wallpapers.next_step: Give the indexing and leaf deployment a more visible, distinctive mechanism.

quality_redesign.change: An open crescent plinth, six exposed mechanical latches, an offset index train and separately readable ticket optics replace the potted ornament.
quality_redesign.limits: Six completion events remain the same fictional service log; no waiting-time prediction.

wallpapers.title: CORAL CRADLE
wallpapers.reason: The useful biological story is carried by a fairly generic arm above a flat nursery tray.
wallpapers.next_step: Reshape the working head and substrate interface; make the cradle itself the protagonist.

quality_redesign.change: A horseshoe nursery with removable radial cassettes, gentle circulation and a short gantry makes the cradle the main subject. The compliant transfer collar contacts fragment bases.
quality_redesign.limits: Original speculative restoration tool. Biological success is not inferred from the drawing.

wallpapers.title: TIDAL LOOM
wallpapers.reason: Twin rotors are legible and detailed, but symmetry and repeated rings make the whole sheet less authored.
wallpapers.next_step: Develop a more specific support architecture and a clearer service asymmetry.

quality_redesign.change: Staggered matched rotor cartridges now have swept triangulated supports, recoverable seabed shoes and a dedicated wet-service spine.
quality_redesign.limits: Same paired shrouded-rotor premise. The flow-power plot is still an ideal available-flux relation, not measured output.

wallpapers.title: PRESENCE RIG
wallpapers.reason: The neutral mannequin communicates scale but dominates a sparse, largely frontal equipment frame.
wallpapers.next_step: Make the interfaces and equipment depth as compelling as the figure.

quality_redesign.change: The human stands on a spatial roller deck within swept load columns. A captive overhead reel, actual suit connections and replaceable floor cassette make the equipment tangible.
quality_redesign.limits: Shared mannequin limb lengths and sole contact retained. Sparse roller bays illustrate a much denser fictional production floor.

wallpapers.title: SLEEP COCOON
wallpapers.reason: The supported occupant is useful, but the promised cocoon reads as a chair with exposed mechanisms.
wallpapers.next_step: Develop the rest-support architecture and a stronger silhouette around the occupant.

quality_redesign.change: A ribbed acoustic canopy, shaped side petals, isolated head support and rear air circuit wrap the existing measured occupant and pelvis linkage.
quality_redesign.limits: The authored seated pose is retained. No health outcome or dynamic recline validation is claimed.

wallpapers.title: WIND KITE
wallpapers.reason: The winch has interest; the long tether and thin wing spread attention without a strong focal form.
wallpapers.next_step: Redesign the wing profile and choose a composition that explains airborne and ground systems together.

quality_redesign.change: A swept airfoil, canted tips, open structural wing bay and shaped ground winch give the airborne and ground systems comparable visual weight.
quality_redesign.limits: The tether is explicitly compressed for the system study; the force-length diagram remains an illustrative cycle.

wallpapers.title: MEETING BUOY
wallpapers.reason: Excellent meeting satire, but a mast, flag and round base have too little visual range across three views.
wallpapers.next_step: Make the timing and flag mechanisms distinctive enough to carry a whole blueprint.

quality_redesign.change: An exposed chronometer and rack-driven semaphore replace the bare mast. Microphone capsules and the manual paddle stay physically distinct from the timing mechanism.
quality_redesign.limits: The same 60-minute fictional meeting log is retained. The flag still cannot mute anyone.

wallpapers.title: MANTA FOIL
wallpapers.reason: The foil mechanics are useful, but the cabin and hull remain too plain compared with Sky Racer.
wallpapers.next_step: Reshape the hull/cabin relationship and develop a more distinctive maritime identity.

quality_redesign.change: Twin wave-piercing hulls, a raised passenger salon and recessed boarding rails replace the blunt single hull. Retractable foil roots and axial guarded propulsors get their own studies.
quality_redesign.limits: Same harbour ferry and retractable-foil premise. Lift-ratio plot is an ideal relationship, not a hull-performance prediction.

wallpapers.title: SEAM SURGEON
wallpapers.reason: The inspection shoe improved, but two large pipes dominate the actual invention.
wallpapers.next_step: Recompose around the travelling collar; reduce the pipe to context and expose the tool train.

quality_redesign.change: Short pipe ends now provide context around the double orbital track. Preparation, filler-fed welding and trailing inspection form a visible tool train.
quality_redesign.limits: The twelve-sector inspection log is fictional and unchanged. Finishing a weld is still separate from accepting it.

wallpapers.title: VOLUMETRIC STAGE
wallpapers.reason: The translucent field and smooth frame leave the central machine visually underdeveloped.
wallpapers.next_step: Give the emitters, alignment system and service hardware a richer physical architecture.

quality_redesign.change: A deep triangulated stage with seventeen articulated optical heads, service ladders, cooling and timing replaces the smooth arch. The luminous locus is restrained.
quality_redesign.limits: Original fictional performance targets retained; particle-response curve now explicitly labelled fictional. No photonics feasibility claim.

wallpapers.title: AROMA ORGAN
wallpapers.reason: The main apparatus has promise, but the receptor inset presents randomly generated values as a named orange-peel response.
wallpapers.next_step: Mandatory correction: replace with a sourced example or explicitly labelled fictional encoding, then reassess.

quality_redesign.change: The random orange-peel receptor matrix is gone. A spatial six-channel metering bank and an explicitly illustrative valve program explain the machine instead.
quality_redesign.limits: Six of 96 fictional hardware channels, not biological receptor measurements. Compact format also receives an explicit concept note.

wallpapers.title: QUIET STAIR
wallpapers.reason: The ordinary stair silhouette lacks futuristic identity; the drawings do not establish a convincing stair-to-platform transformation.
wallpapers.next_step: Rebuild the concept around a demonstrable kinematic sequence before adding more detail.

quality_redesign.change: Four fixed-x treads now ride independent vertical screw guides. A same-scale sequence shows stair, level-low and level-high states; the manual release and edge sensor remain separate.
quality_redesign.limits: Endpoint kinematics checked. Authored concept, not a certified access lift, complete control system or collision simulation.
